newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.

text.p: * American Express Co is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.89, compared to $0.77 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 61 Friday.
* Dime Bancorp Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.31, compared to $0.20 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 15-5/8.
* Estee Lauder Cos Inc is expected to report second quarter earnings per share of $0.52, compared to $0.45 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 51-1/4.
* Mobil Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.97, compared to $1.89 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 128-5/8.
* Washington Post Co is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $5.49, compared to $4.80 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 326-1/4.
* International Business Machines Corp was up 1/4 at 150-7/8 in London after last week's slide. Intel Corp was up 3/8 at 150-7/8 and Texas Instruments Inc added 1/8 to 69-1/4.
